difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the ideal multiple of a pushforward along an affine morphism with the pushforward of the submodule generated by the inverse image ideal, with the notation carefully explained (statement lines 3385-3393). The proof spells out the action of the inverse image ideal, observes that the generated submodule is quasi-coherent as the image of a natural map, and reduces etale locally on the target to the scheme case. The notation and the locality reduction are the substance, so the claim is H2.
